subject: Post-discovery: align on demo window, evaluation scenarios, and success criteria
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Montoya <alex.montoya@carespectra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: align on demo window, evaluation scenarios, and success criteria

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a constructive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce average claims triage time by 30% while preserving accuracy on red-flag detection.
- Priority workflows: inbound claims intake and two-stage triage (initial triage + follow-up verification).
- Data constraints: de-identified historical claims extracts (~6 months), access via S3, and strict retention policy.

Proposed next meeting: technical demo + evaluation kickoff where we walk the team through:
1) Trial plan and timelines (30-day pilot with milestone checks)
2) Success criteria (latency, precision/recall on red-flag labels, cost per 1k tokens)
3) Example prompt set and eval harness we’ll run against a small labeled sample
4) Roles/owners, calendar for weekly checkpoints and access details

Two windows that work for our engineering + solutions team:
- Thu 22 Apr 2027 09:00–10:00 PT
- Fri 23 Apr 2027 11:00–12:00 PT

Please confirm which slot works (or propose 2 alternatives) and who from your side should join (engineering, security, procurement). I’ve attached a brief MVP_trial_plan.docx and a small prompt_samples.csv so you can scan ahead.

Goal for the meeting: lock the pilot charter and attendees so we can send calendar invites and pre-reqs.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: MVP_trial_plan.docx (docx, 42KB)]
[Attachment: prompt_samples.csv (csv, 8KB)]

From: Alex Montoya <alex.montoya@carespectra.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Choi <sara.choi@carespectra.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: align on demo window, evaluation scenarios, and success criteria

Hi Jasmine —

Appreciate the recap and the materials. The team reviewed the prompt samples and they look reasonable. We’d like the following:
- Please include one example of how Redwood would handle a triage rule that uses both structured and free-text fields (we have a few hybrid rules).
- Security will want a short run-through of data handling (S3 access, retention, KMS) as part of the kickoff.

Regarding timing, the Thu 22 Apr 09:00 PT works for our engineering lead (Sara) and me. Sara is CC’d. Procurement will sit in the background for the first call but may join the second checkpoint.

Also: can you add an initial estimate for token cost during the 30-day pilot (order-of-magnitude is fine)? We want to set expectations for finance.

Thanks — see you Thursday.

Best,
Alex
Alex Montoya
Head of Product | CareSpectra
alex.montoya@carespectra.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Montoya <alex.montoya@carespectra.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: align on demo window, evaluation scenarios, and success criteria

Thanks Alex — confirming Thu 22 Apr 09:00–10:00 PT. I’ve created a provisional calendar invite and included a short agenda below; Jasmine will send the invite from her calendar shortly.

Agenda (45–60 mins):
- 0–10: Quick product demo focused on triage flows
- 10–25: Trial plan and milestones (what we’ll deliver in 30 days)
- 25–40: Data & security checklist (S3 access, KMS, retention policy)
- 40–60: Success criteria, prompt set walkthrough, and Q&A

Pre-reqs for the call:
- A small labeled sample (<= 2k rows) or anonymized extract we can use for initial eval
- Any runbook for hybrid rules you mentioned (structured + free text)

Alex — provisional invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=care-demo-9873 (please accept/forward to anyone who should join). Jasmine — cc: can you add the token cost ballpark to the deck and attach to the invite?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Perfect — calendar invite is live and I attached a one-slide cost estimate. Action items before the call (assigned):
- CareSpectra: share a small anonymized sample (Sara) and the hybrid rule examples (Alex) — due Wed 21 Apr EOD PT (if possible).
- Redwood: provide token cost ballpark + short runbook for S3/KMS access (Jasmine) and a run-through checklist for the 30-day pilot (Ben).

If anything shifts, I’ll update the invite. Looking forward to the session.

—Jasmine
